items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And in that same show was Angel Viloria’s Conjunto. There was a singer named Canelina who did Afro-Cuban singing and the dancing couple and me. That was the show. We toured the entire republic with that show.

ctx.x: With whom else did you perform there in Santo Domingo?

Well, the singer Lopez Balaguer took us. And in that same show was Angel Viloria’s Conjunto. There was a singer named Canelina who did Afro-Cuban singing and the dancing couple and me. That was the show. We toured the entire republic with that show.
So then there was Balaguer who was a bolero singer, Angel Viloria . . .
